question: How many players are there in a Field Hockey team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Field hockey:**

__
 
• It is a team sport **played with 11 players**, consisting of 10 field players and a goalkeeper.
 
• According to the** International Hockey Federation (FIH)**, "the roots of hockey are buried deep in antiquity".
 
• Early forms of hockey were played in Egypt and Persia around 2000 BC, and in Ethiopia around 1000 BC, according to historical records.
 
• The **pitch is a 91.4 m × 55 m** (100.0 yd × 60.1 yd) rectangular field.
 
• **Famous Hockey players** from India:
 
 
• **Dilip Tirkey**, Bimal Lakra, **Dhyan Chand**, Leslie Claudius, Ajit Pal Singh, **Dhanraj Pillay**, **Vandana Katariya**, Nikki Pradhan, Navjot Kaur, **Salima Tete**, etc.
